svg.title: Workers' Comp Cost and Recovery Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-comp-cost-recovery-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Workers' Comp Cost and Recovery Roadmap; subtitle: Classification, mod levers, first-aid controls, and lien defense; caption: Practitioners find the money in classification, mod management, audit documentation, and disciplined lien and clawback defense.; assumptions note: The four-week cadence is an editorial ordering of practitioner gates. No speaker prescribed a weekly schedule, and results depend on state rules and the account.; note: Sources are Insurance for Entrepreneurs, Nia Brooks, Joe Stevens of Bridge Safety Consultants via Employers Group, Jeremy Burris, Insurance Brokers of Arizona, Theresa Kenyon of Synergy, and Medical Lien Management.; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Classification Check; deliverable: Class codes matched to real operations. One mental-health program moved from a home health code to a doctor's office code cut premium about 80% on $2.5M payroll.; gate: Actual time records for any split payroll, or the whole payroll goes to the highest-rated code.; week: Week 2; title: Mod and Credit Levers; deliverable: Mod impact sized, since a $200k base premium swings from $150k at a 0.75 mod to $300k at 1.50. Credits checked include a 2% safety credit, 5% drug-free workplace credit, and 5% deviated rate.; gate: Full cooperation with the annual audit, since refusal can cost up to 3x annual premium.; week: Week 3; title: First-Aid and Exit Controls; deliverable: Clinic dispenses 600 mg ibuprofen instead of 800 mg to keep a first aid from becoming a recordable, and departing employees sign an injury-free statement.; gate: Claims filed after termination are contested.; week: Week 4; title: Lien and Clawback Defense; deliverable: 1024(b)(4) request sent to the plan administrator with the $110-per-day penalty as leverage, and lien itemizations audited. Synergy reports 30-78% average reductions.; gate: No bulk overpayment refund until the timeline, auditor authority, and 12- or 24-month look-back are verified.
